counterfactual_missing_items: absence of cardiomyopathy pattern on echocardiogram
absence of prior structural heart disease
decisive_items: diffuse large B-cell lymphoma diagnosed 4 years ago
diffuse medium masses in the right atrium
significantly increased metabolic activity along the right atrial myocardium and adjacent pericardium
response.rationale: R3 is strongly supported by the patient's history of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma and imaging showing right atrial masses with increased metabolic activity, directly indicating cardiac lymphoma. R1 and R4 rely on non-specific findings (chemotherapy history, elevated NT-proBNP, ECG changes) and are contradicted by the absence of typical cardiomyopathy or amyloidosis features. C1 is a redundant completion of R3, adding no new evidence.

rejected.why: Redundant completion of R3; adds no new evidence beyond the same imaging spans.
Chemotherapy history and elevated NT-proBNP are non-specific; imaging shows masses, not cardiomyopathy.
ECG and NT-proBNP findings are non-specific; no amyloidosis-specific features and imaging shows masses.
